newsitem.title: USA: Eateries says on track for record profits.
newsitem.headline: Eateries says on track for record profits.

text.p: Eateries Inc said Monday it feels it is on track to achieve record results on revenues, profits and cash flow for 1997.
The company, a mall-based dinner-house operator, based its prediction on improvements in 1997 profits to date.

"Our first and second quarter results have met or exceeded analysts' forecasted results," company president Vincent Orza said in a statement. "Trailing twelve months' earnings increased to $0.25 per share as compared with $0.02 per share for the same period a year ago."
The company posted second quarter income of $24,000, or $0.01 per share, compared with a loss of 166,000, or $0.04 per share, for the year-ago period.
